Travel Booking Analytics

Travel & Tourism Booking Analytics

50,000 unique bookings, Aug 2023 to Aug 2026. Every filter applies to every page. Click a bar to filter by it.

Cleaning: 500 duplicate bookings removed; missing city/country filled from the data where unambiguous (185 remain "Unknown"); missing discount counted as $0; missing price or rating left blank and excluded from averages. Revenue = booking value of all bookings. Cancellation rate = cancelled / (cancelled + completed), bookings with no status excluded.
